meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 用户请求写提交信息时,Claude 会生成极简的 Conventional Commits 消息:主题≤50字符,正文仅在必要时解释原因;遵循类型、命令式语气等规则,只输出可粘贴的代码块,不执行 git 命令。
howto.when: 当你说出“write a commit”、“commit message”、“generate commit”等请求,或调用 /caveman-commit,或暂存更改时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我写个 commit message,说明这次改动的原因。
say.note: 触发技能生成符合格式的提交信息。

say.text: 用 /caveman-commit 为暂存的更改生成提交信息。
say.note: 直接调用技能,自动分析暂存内容。

say.text: 写一个 fix 类型的 commit,范围是 login,主题是修复登录超时。
say.note: 按指定类型和范围生成提交消息。

howto.what_en: When asked for a commit message, Claude generates a terse Conventional Commits message: subject ≤50 chars, body only when needed; follows type, imperative-mood rules, and outputs a paste-ready code block without running git commit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'write a commit', 'commit message', 'generate commit', etc., or invokes /caveman-commit. Also auto-triggers when files are staged.

say_en.text: Write a commit message explaining why this change was made.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to generate a compliant commit message.

say_en.text: Use /caveman-commit to generate a commit message for the staged changes.
say_en.note: Invokes the skill directly; it analyzes the staged diff.

say_en.text: Write a fix(login): fix login timeout commit.
say_en.note: The skill formats the message with the specified type and scope.
